XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Misfiring and loss of power after a short drive
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | ENGINE | P0301 | P0304 | COIL | IGNITION | SPARK PLUGS | SPARK PLUG | CYLINDERS | CYLINDER | TURNS | BADLY | IGNITES | IRREGULAR | LOSES | ROAD | SHORT | JOURNEY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage technician; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Ignition coil

  • Fault: After a short journey, the vehicle experiences misfires with a loss of power. Restarting the vehicle temporarily resolves the problem.

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P0300 (Missed ignition in unspecified cylinders – Fault)
    • P0304 (Missed ignition in cylinder 4 – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty ignition coil

• Action: Check that the ignition coil is working correctly and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the engine is fitted with a single ignition coil which controls the 4 spark plugs on the cylinders.
    The faulty component showed signs of oxidation on the 4th cylinder’s lead, starting from the timing chain; following replacement of the coil, the fault was permanently resolved.
